name: WARNING: Pasta alla Puttanesca (Capers, Olives, Anchovies & Hot Pepper)
whyItWorks: Pungent sauce containing crushed hot chili peppers, briny pickled capers, whole black olives, and acidic tomato sauce. Extreme osmolarity from brine and sodium combined with capsaicin burns intestinal lining.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid Puttanesca sauce entirely. Stick to simple pastas with olive oil or pure chicken broth.
